questions.question: Describe the education a boy would receive at a grammar school in Elizabethan England. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: At a grammar school, a boy would study Latin grammar (using Lily's Grammar), read classical authors like Cicero and Virgil, study Greek, rhetoric, and logic. School hours were long (6am-5pm), discipline was harsh (beatings with a birch rod), and all teaching was in Latin. Holidays were limited, and boys were punished for speaking English in school.

questions.question: Explain the role of the gentry in Elizabethan government. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The gentry served as: Justices of the Peace (unpaid local magistrates who maintained law and order, handled minor crimes, and enforced the Religious Settlement); Members of Parliament in the House of Commons; commissioners for collecting taxes and mustering troops; sheriffs and other local officials.
